descriptions.w3d_d30g_game_init_data_8006e784: Game start bookkeeping: unless already seeded, seeds both random generators from the application seed or the elapsed milliseconds (0 under flag 0x00200000) and logs the game count; reads GM.GameInitData and, with more than one player, tallies active teams by kind, advances each team's cycle index (random start when -1), advances the starting team skipping empty kinds, and advances the per-kind turn index.
